Reclassify selected system-created archive and generic configuration records using process-stamp checks and exclusion lists. Capture a custom-preference exclusion set, normalize USER_DEF fields with environment-specific override handling, and replace selected archive process identifiers. Remove two specifically selected archive preferences and associated filter records. Allocate a system-config numeric key beginning at 5000 using an observed gap or maximum-plus-one fallback, then insert a fixed runbook-related system setting or update the existing setting key. cFilterDelete removes filters and preferences for eligible discovered tables/type records when the applicable environment override is absent. Later updates derive USER_DEF5/ACTIVE/RUN_BY_DEFAULT, USER_DEF6/SAVE_DATA and USER_DEF7/DAYS_HIST with special type groups, exclusions and environment branches. cArchiveCreate enumerates eligible base tables plus synthesized process/transaction history type names and inserts missing archive preferences. Four explicitly added tables are LABEL_PRINT_REQUEST, SSRS_PRINTING_REQUEST, UPLOAD_LOCATION_INVENTORY_ATTRIBUTES and UPLOAD_SERIAL_NUMBER. Parent archive identifiers and dynamic handler identifiers are stored as metadata; those handlers are not invoked by this body. cFilterCreate deletes and rebuilds filter header/detail/statement rows for selected preferences. It stores dynamic filter SELECT text for WORK_ORDER_HEADER and WORK_INSTRUCTION condition tests, LAUNCH_STATISTICS closed tests, and PROCESS_HISTORY/TRANSACTION_HISTORY type tests. It then attaches DATA_FILTER. These filter texts are persisted here rather than executed here. When DeleteLoopLimit is positive, cArchiveTruncate selects child archive tables whose parent preference has saving disabled, active enabled and default-run enabled, plus special process/transaction archive cases when no corresponding type preference requests saving. A metadata row-count existence test narrows targets; each non-null target is immediately TRUNCATE TABLE through QUOTENAME. There is no row/batch cap on a selected truncate. cArchiveDelete selects eligible archive preferences with saving disabled and active/default-run enabled. These type-specific deletes have no age predicate and no ORDER BY; they perform TOP 500000 up to ten iterations per cursor row. The same underlying table can be visited through more than one preference. Finally update scheduled-job activation/next-run metadata differently for the fixed environment groups, clear selected PARAMETER_DATA, and adjust active interval jobs with frequency below five minutes by adding five minutes to NEXT_RUN_DATE_TIME and setting minimum frequency five, subject to the stated USER_DEF6 exclusion. No scheduler is invoked here. UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE ARCHIVE_PREFERENCES; UPDATE GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL; INSERT/UPDATE SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL. DELETE/INSERT FILTER_CONFIG_HEADER, FILTER_CONFIG_DETAIL and FILTER_STATEMENT; UPDATE SCHEDULED_JOBS. Dynamic TRUNCATE TABLE on selected archive table names; dynamic DELETE CTE on age-qualified selected tables and type-qualified AR_PROCESS_HISTORY/AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY. Local table-variable inserts and cursor state only in addition to the above persistent effects. sp_executesql for each eligible truncate, age-delete, process-history delete and transaction-history delete. AND (CASE WHEN PROCESS_STAMP LIKE N'<literal:154>' THEN SUBSTRING(PROCESS_STAMP, 9, 1) ELSE NULL END NOT LIKE '<literal:155>'
WHERE (SYSTEM_CREATED = N'<literal:210>' AND (USER_DEF2 IS NULL OR USER_DEF2 != N'<literal:211>'))
SET USER_DEF1 = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END IS NULL
OR CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END <> N'<literal:284>') AND USER_DEF1 IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE USER_DEF1 END,
USER_DEF2 = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END IS NULL

OR CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END <> N'<literal:285>') AND USER_DEF2 IS NOT NULL AND USER_DEF2 != N'<literal:286>' THEN NULL ELSE USER_DEF2 END,
USER_DEF3 = CASE WHEN USER_DEF3 IS NOT NULL AND USER_DEF3 != N'<literal:287>' THEN NULL ELSE USER_DEF3 END,
USER_DEF4 = CASE WHEN USER_DEF4 IS NOT NULL AND USER_DEF4 != N'<literal:288>' THEN NULL ELSE USER_DEF4 END,
USER_DEF5 = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END IS NULL

OR CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END <> N'<literal:289>') AND USER_DEF5 IS NOT NULL AND USER_DEF5 NOT IN (N'<literal:290>', N'<literal:291>') THEN NULL ELSE USER_DEF5 END,
USER_DEF6 = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END IS NULL

OR CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END <> N'<literal:292>') AND USER_DEF6 IS NOT NULL AND USER_DEF6 NOT IN (N'<literal:293>', N'<literal:294>') THEN NULL ELSE USER_DEF6 END,
USER_DEF7 = CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END IS NULL
OR CASE WHEN (SELECT @@SERVERNAME) IN (SELECT DB_SERVER FROM @NonProdServerList) THEN USER_DEF3 ELSE USER_DEF4 END <> N'<literal:295>') AND USER_DEF7 IS NOT NULL
SET ARCHIVE_PROCESS = (SELECT TOP 1 IDENTIFIER FROM DYNAMIC_CALLING_DETAIL WHERE RECORD_TYPE='<literal:296>' AND DESCRIPTION='<literal:297>')
AND ISNULL(ARCHIVE_PROCESS, N'<literal:299>') <> ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 IDENTIFIER FROM DYNAMIC_CALLING_DETAIL WHERE RECORD_TYPE='<literal:300>' AND DESCRIPTION='<literal:301>'), N'<literal:302>');
SET @stArchiveID = (SELECT ARCHIVE_ID FROM ARCHIVE_PREFERENCES WHERE ARCHIVE_NAME = N'<literal:303>');
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FILTER_CONFIG_HEADER WHERE RECORD_TYPE = N'<literal:304>' + @stArchiveID)
SET @stArchiveID = (SELECT ARCHIVE_ID FROM ARCHIVE_PREFERENCES WHERE ARCHIVE_NAME = N'<literal:308>');
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FILTER_CONFIG_HEADER WHERE RECORD_TYPE = N'<literal:309>' + @stArchiveID)
AND CAST(CASE WHEN SYS_KEY NOT LIKE N'<literal:313>' THEN SYS_KEY ELSE 0 END AS INT) = 5000) IS NULL
SET @stArchiveID = (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(T.SYS_KEY AS INT) + 1 AS NEXT_AVAILABLE_NUMBER
LEAD(CAST(SYS_KEY AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY SYS_KEY) AS NEXT_NUMBER
AND CAST(CASE WHEN SYS_KEY NOT LIKE N'<literal:315>' THEN SYS_KEY ELSE 0 END AS INT) BETWEEN 5000 AND 9999
AND CAST(SYS_KEY AS INT) BETWEEN 5000 AND 9999
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL WHERE DESCRIPTION = N'<literal:316>')
ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL WHERE DESCRIPTION = N'<literal:326>')
DECLARE cFilterDelete CURSOR FAST_FORWARD READ_ONLY FOR
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE N'<literal:331>' + UPPER(LEFT(DB_NAME(), 4)) + N'<literal:332>'

program.text: declare loadInventoryCursor CURSOR LOCAL STATIC READ_ONLY FORWARD_ONLY
select item, company, location, quantity, quantity_um, status, lot,
item_description, received_date, LPN, N'<literal:1>', object_id,user_def5,user_def3,user_def4, process_stamp
and user_def1 is null and quantity > 0 -- [comment omitted]

exec @iError = INV_AdjustInv N'<literal:6>', N'<literal:7>', N'<literal:8>', N'<literal:9>', null, N'<literal:10>', N'<literal:11>', N'<literal:12>', N'<literal:13>', 0.0, @dQuantity, 0, 0, @stCompany, null,@stExpDateLot, N'<literal:14>', -- [comment omitted]
null, null, null, @stInvSts, @stItem, @stItemDescription, @stLot, @manufacturedate, @stQtyUm, null, null, null, -- [comment omitted]
null, @stLPN, @stLocation, @stWarehouse, N'<literal:15>', @user_def3, null, null, null, @user_def4, @user_def5, 0.0, 0.0, @stUserName,  null, -- [comment omitted]
update LOCATION_INVENTORY set RECEIVED_DATE = isnull(@receiveddate, getdate())
ITEM = @stItem and LOCATION = @stLocation and warehouse = @stWarehouse and isnull(lot, '<literal:18>')  = isnull(@stLot, '<literal:19>')
and isnull(LOGISTICS_UNIT, '<literal:20>') = isnull(@stLPN, '<literal:21>') and isnull(company, '<literal:22>') = isnull(@stCompany, '<literal:23>') ;

AND SC.INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = (SELECT max(INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM) FROM SHIPPING_CONTAINER WHERE INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM = @INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM)
LEFT OUTER JOIN WORK_INSTRUCTION_VIEW AS WIV ON WIV.WORK_UNIT = SC.CONTAINER_ID

program.text: SELECT N'<literal:4>' AS SCALAR, count(INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM) AS ParentContainers from SHIPPING_CONTAINER sc
LEFT OUTER JOIN Shipping_load sl ON sh.SHIPPING_LOAD_NUM = sl.INTERNAL_LOAD_NUM;
case when (select count(distinct USER_DEF1) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(USER_DEF1) END AS UserDef1,
case when (select count(distinct USER_DEF2) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(USER_DEF2) END AS UserDef2,
case when (select count(distinct USER_DEF3) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(USER_DEF3) END AS UserDef3,
case when (select count(distinct USER_DEF4) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(USER_DEF4) END AS UserDef4,
case when (select count(distinct USER_DEF5) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(USER_DEF5) END AS UserDef5,
case when (select count(distinct USER_DEF6) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(USER_DEF6) END AS UserDef6 ,
case when (select count(distinct INVOICE)   from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(INVOICE) END AS Invoice,
case when (select count(distinct PICK_LIST_ID) from SHIPMENT_DETAIL where INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum) > 1 then null else min(PICK_LIST_ID) END AS PickListId

CREATE EVENT SESSION DeadlockGraph ON DATABASE
ALTER EVENT SESSION LongRunningQueries ON DATABASE STATE = START;
ALTER EVENT SESSION BlockedProcessReport ON DATABASE STATE = START;

source_structure.declaration: CREATE PROCEDURE SHP_MonitorCustomerCategoryChartData @filterCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX), @culture NVARCHAR(10) AS

program.text: SELECT @warehouse = filterValue FROM @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = N'<literal:1>'
SELECT @customerCat1 = filterValue from @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = N'<literal:2>'
CATEGORY = CASE WHEN  CUSTOMER_NAME IS NULL THEN dbo.RSCMfn_RtrvResource(N'<literal:6>',N'<literal:7>',@culture) ELSE  CUSTOMER_NAME END,
DESCRIPTION = CASE WHEN  CUSTOMER_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CUSTOMER_NAME END,
((@customerCat1 is null AND CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1 is null ) OR CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1=@customerCat1) AND SHIPMENT_HEADER_TRAILING_STS <900

@TOTAL_SHIPPING_LOAD =COUNT(DISTINCT(SHIPPING_LOAD_NUM)) FROM Metadata_Insight_Shipment_View WHERE WAREHOUSE=@warehouse and ((@customerCat1 is null AND CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1 is null ) OR CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1=@customerCat1) AND SHIPMENT_HEADER_TRAILING_STS <900 ;

SELECT @WIP_SHIPMENTS =COUNT(DISTINCT(INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM)) FROM Metadata_Insight_Shipment_View WHERE WAREHOUSE=@warehouse  AND ((@customerCat1 is null AND CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1 is null ) OR CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1=@customerCat1)
AND ((@customerCat1 is null AND CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1 is null ) OR CUSTOMER_CATEGORY1=@customerCat1)
SELECT TOP 1 N'<literal:12>' AS SUMMARYTILE_TOTAL_SHIPMENTS,  @TOTAL_SHIPMENTS AS TOTAL_SHIPMENTS;
SELECT TOP 1 N'<literal:13>' AS SUMMARYTILE_TOTAL_SHIPPING_LOADS,  @TOTAL_SHIPPING_LOAD AS TOTAL_SHIPPING_LOADS;
SELECT TOP 1 N'<literal:14>' AS SUMMARYTILE_WIP_SHIPMENTS,  @WIP_SHIPMENTS AS WIP_SHIPMENTS;
SELECT TOP 1 N'<literal:15>' AS SUMMARYTILE_SHIPMENTS_NOT_STARTED_PICKING, @SHIPMENT_NOT_PICKING AS SHIPMENTS_NOT_STARTED_PICKING;

source_structure.declaration: CREATE PROCEDURE RCPT_MonitorReceiptsDatesChartData @filterCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX), @culture NVARCHAR(10) AS

program.text: SELECT @warehouse = filterValue from @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = N'<literal:1>'
SET @PAST_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) < (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate)) AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL );
SET @TODAY_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) = (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate)) AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
SET @TOM_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) = (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate+1)) AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
SET @FUTURE_COUNT=(SELECT COUNT(RECEIPT_DATE) from RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE CONVERT(DATE,RECEIPT_DATE) > (SELECT CONVERT(DATE,@wareHouseDate))
AND warehouse=@warehouse  AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL);
FROM RECEIPT_HEADER WHERE WAREHOUSE = @warehouse AND CLOSE_DATE IS NULL;

functional_roles.rationale: Initialize fixed preference/type groups and a four-entry nonproduction server-name list; choose environment branches using @@SERVERNAME. Initialize history-day constants 7, 30, 90, 180 and 372, delete-loop limit 10 and per-delete TOP limit 500000. These are implementation values, not recommended retention policy. Reclassify selected system-created archive and generic configuration records using process-stamp checks and exclusion lists. Capture a custom-preference exclusion set, normalize USER_DEF fields with environment-specific override handling, and replace selected archive process identifiers. Remove two specifically selected archive preferences and associated filter records. Allocate a system-config numeric key beginning at 5000 using an observed gap or maximum-plus-one fallback, then insert a fixed runbook-related system setting or update the existing setting key. cFilterDelete removes filters and preferences for eligible discovered tables/type records when the applicable environment override is absent. Later updates derive USER_DEF5/ACTIVE/RUN_BY_DEFAULT, USER_DEF6/SAVE_DATA and USER_DEF7/DAYS_HIST with special type groups, exclusions and environment branches. cArchiveCreate enumerates eligible base tables plus synthesized process/transaction history type names and inserts missing archive preferences. Four explicitly added tables are LABEL_PRINT_REQUEST, SSRS_PRINTING_REQUEST, UPLOAD_LOCATION_INVENTORY_ATTRIBUTES and UPLOAD_SERIAL_NUMBER. Parent archive identifiers and dynamic handler identifiers are stored as metadata; those handlers are not invoked by this body. cFilterCreate deletes and rebuilds filter header/detail/statement rows for selected preferences. It stores dynamic filter SELECT text for WORK_ORDER_HEADER and WORK_INSTRUCTION condition tests, LAUNCH_STATISTICS closed tests, and PROCESS_HISTORY/TRANSACTION_HISTORY type tests. It then attaches DATA_FILTER. These filter texts are persisted here rather than executed here. When DeleteLoopLimit is positive, cArchiveTruncate selects child archive tables whose parent preference has saving disabled, active enabled and default-run enabled, plus special process/transaction archive cases when no corresponding type preference requests saving. A metadata row-count existence test narrows targets; each non-null target is immediately TRUNCATE TABLE through QUOTENAME. There is no row/batch cap on a selected truncate. cArchiveDelete selects eligible archive preferences with saving disabled and active/default-run enabled. For each non-null target and positive DAYS_HIST, it constructs an age-based delete: DATE_TIME_STAMP <= CONVERT(DATE, GETUTCDATE()-DAYS_HIST), TOP 500000 ordered by DATE_TIME_STAMP, repeated ten times after one initial existence test. Two subsequent cHistDelete passes target AR_PROCESS_HISTORY and AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY by configured type with saving disabled and active/default-run enabled. These type-specific deletes have no age predicate and no ORDER BY; they perform TOP 500000 up to ten iterations per cursor row. The same underlying table can be visited through more than one preference. Finally update scheduled-job activation/next-run metadata differently for the fixed environment groups, clear selected PARAMETER_DATA, and adjust active interval jobs with frequency below five minutes by adding five minutes to NEXT_RUN_DATE_TIME and setting minimum frequency five, subject to the stated USER_DEF6 exclusion. No scheduler is invoked here. UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE ARCHIVE_PREFERENCES; UPDATE GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL; INSERT/UPDATE SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL. DELETE/INSERT FILTER_CONFIG_HEADER, FILTER_CONFIG_DETAIL and FILTER_STATEMENT; UPDATE SCHEDULED_JOBS. Dynamic TRUNCATE TABLE on selected archive table names; dynamic DELETE CTE on age-qualified selected tables and type-qualified AR_PROCESS_HISTORY/AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY. Local table-variable inserts and cursor state only in addition to the above persistent effects. sp_executesql for each eligible truncate, age-delete, process-history delete and transaction-history delete. No other stored-procedure call is present. Reading DYNAMIC_CALLING_DETAIL and storing ARCHIVE_PROCESS does not execute that handler.

reviewed_roles.purpose: Queue and execute index/statistics maintenance with optional persistent logging.

functional_roles.rationale: Privately verified operations index/statistics/all and modes smart/dummy; invalid non-NULL mode resets smart, NULL mode remainsNULL. Invalid/NULL operation prints help but does not return: it can still create AzureSQLMaintenanceLog even LogToTable=0, and optional logging/retention still runs. Index discovery uses LIMITED physical stats and index types1/2; smart queues page_count>40 and fragmentation>=5, reorganizing strictly>5 and<30, so exactly5 rebuilds. Dummy means broad real maintenance, not dry-run; OR dummy bypasses preceding queue predicates. Partition rows can produce repeated whole-index commands because partition_number is not inserted into command. Online-support heuristic checks index_id>=1000 only within prefiltered temp data. Statistics selects non-sys rows with modifications or dummy and forms rows/modification info, which can divide by zero. Unordered DELETE TOP1 queue executes each command inside TRY/CATCH, optionally logs command/status using SCOPE_IDENTITY, then continues after errors. Keeps three most recent distinct operation times when logging. Unsuffixed payload uses plain REORGANIZE, REBUILD MAXDOP=1 with ONLINE ON/OFF choice, and UPDATE STATISTICS WITH FULLSCAN.

help_topics.business_question: How generic dashboard metrics choose count or sum
